steps: 1. Orientation and plan record (no code yet). Read docs/index.md, docs/capability_status_matrix.md, specs/state.md (sections 'State File Schema', 'State Integrity and Recovery', 'Reusable-Call State Contract'), docs/design/workflow_lisp_frontend_specification.md (generated pure_projection surface) and the lexical-checkpoint design doc routed from docs/design/README.md. Write the execution plan to docs/plans/2026-10-18-derived-pure-result-persistence-profile-plan.md, recording the module split below and the assumptions: (a) the profile constant and its validator live in orchestrator/state.py and are re-exported by orchestrator/workflow/pure_result_replay.py, so state.py never imports orchestrator.workflow (no import cycle); (b) new replay code is split into submodules to respect the 500-line limit, with orchestrator/workflow/pure_result_replay.py as the single import facade the acceptance tests use.

2. Profile selector on RunState and StateManager (orchestrator/state.py). Add DERIVED_PURE_REPLAY_PROFILE = 'derived_pure_replay.v1' and a validate_result_persistence_profile(value) helper that raises ValueError naming the profile for any non-None value other than the constant. Add the optional keyword field result_persistence_profile: str | None = None to RunState, validated in __post_init__; to_dict() omits the key when None; from_dict() reads data.get('result_persistence_profile') so payloads without it round-trip unchanged. Extend StateManager.initialize(workflow_file, context=None, bound_inputs=None, observability=None, result_persistence_profile=None): validate before mkdir/checksum and write the field in the same atomic _write_state. In StateManager.load() validate via RunState.from_dict before any write path (no backfill, no rewrite), so a bad value raises ValueError and leaves the state file byte-for-byte unchanged. SCHEMA_VERSION stays '2.1'. Tests in tests/test_state_manager.py: construction rejects unknown value, initialize rejects it, load of a tampered file raises and the file bytes are unchanged, absent field round-trips with no key, present field round-trips.

3. Value-free completion shell, witness and progress classifier: new module orchestrator/workflow/pure_result_shell.py (stdlib-only, no orchestrator.workflow imports). Define the frozen dataclass PureReplayVisitWitness(presentation_key, step_index, step_id, visit_count); build_pure_completion_shell(witness) returning the exact literal dict (name, step_id, visit_count 1, status completed, exit_code 0, outcome {status completed, phase execution, class completed, retryable false}, result_storage 'derived_pure_replay.v1') built directly; validate_pure_completion_shell(row, *, witness) requiring exact key set and exact values (rejects value/output/text/json/artifacts/debug/duration_ms/output_bundle and any other extra or missing key); build_running_pure_cursor(witness, now) producing the exact current_step shape {name,index,type:'pure_projection',step_id,visit_count,status:'running',started_at,last_heartbeat_at}; classify_pure_replay_progress(state, *, witness) -> 'unstarted' | 'interrupted' | 'derived_complete' | 'durable_failure_skip', raising PureResultReplayIndexError('progress_witness_invalid', ...) for every other combination listed in the task (visit without cursor/row, cursor or shell without visit, cursor+row, identity/index/type/status/visit mismatch, value-bearing completion, non-terminal row, cursor+failure). Put PureResultReplayIndexError (ValueError subclass, code 'pure_result_replay_unavailable', reason, context) and the reason constants (DEPENDENCY_INDEX_INVALID, MULTIPLE_VISIT_REGION, 'reachability_ambiguous', 'progress_witness_invalid', 'profile_conflict', and the replay failure reasons) in this module so state.py can import it lazily. Tests: new tests/test_workflow_pure_result_shell.py, one behaviour per test, table-driven over each invalid classifier case.

4. Atomic StateManager visit transactions (orchestrator/state.py, mirrored in orchestrator/workflow/call_frame_state.py _CallFrameStateManager using its existing leaf-mutation/_persist pattern). Add begin_eligible_pure_visit(*, step_name, step_index, step_id) -> int (increments step_visits and publishes the running cursor in one _state_mutation), reuse_interrupted_eligible_pure_visit(witness) -> int (classify == 'interrupted', no write), settle_eligible_pure_success(witness) (writes build_pure_completion_shell into steps, clears current_step, returns the shell), settle_eligible_pure_failure(witness, result) (requires failed/skipped StepResult, writes full row, clears cursor, returns None). Each method validates the witness against the current cursor/visit before mutating. Import pure_result_shell lazily inside the methods. Tests in tests/test_state_manager.py plus a call-frame case in tests/test_subworkflow_calls.py proving the frame manager writes through the parent atomically.

5. Facade module orchestrator/workflow/pure_result_replay.py: re-export DERIVED_PURE_REPLAY_PROFILE, DEPENDENCY_INDEX_INVALID, MULTIPLE_VISIT_REGION, PureResultReplayIndexError, PureReplayVisitWitness, build_pure_completion_shell, validate_pure_completion_shell, classify_pure_replay_progress, and (after steps 6 and 10) derive_pure_result_replay_index, PureResultReplayIndex, _propagate_pure_ineligibility and PureReplayRuntime. Add an import smoke test to tests/test_workflow_pure_result_shell.py.

6. Replay index derivation: new module orchestrator/workflow/pure_result_replay_index.py. Implement derive_pure_result_replay_index(bundle, *, scope_kind='root') reading the loaded bundle's runtime plan / executable IR (orchestrator/workflow/loaded_bundle.py, runtime_plan.py, executable_ir.py) without mutating or re-serializing it. Collect pure_projection nodes whose bundle provenance frontend_kind is 'workflow_lisp' (compiler-generated); build node records (node_id, step_id, presentation_key, bindings with path + typed address from pure_projection.binding_refs, output_addresses, output_contracts, pure_dependency_node_ids, durable_dependency_node_ids). Walk binding value documents: only exact {'ref': ...} leaves form edges (reuse orchestrator/workflow/references.py parsing); malformed ref objects, unbound text, cross-frame refs, duplicate projection authority and projection identity mismatch raise dependency_index_invalid; literal subtrees (including inactive union members) are checked against the declared binding type with the existing type/contract validators from orchestrator/workflow/pure_expr.py and orchestrator/contracts. Mark loop-owned (repeat_until_frame nested_body_node_ids, for_each bodies) and otherwise multiply visited nodes ineligible with reason 'multiple_visit_region'; module-level _propagate_pure_ineligibility(nodes, reasons) carries ineligibility to pure nodes that depend on ineligible pure nodes; detect cycles (dependency_index_invalid) and produce topological_node_ids. Determine the bundle's actual scope (root vs imported callee, indexing only the callee's own nodes) and raise dependency_index_invalid with context expected_scope/actual_scope on mismatch. PureResultReplayIndex.required_pure_node_ids(seed_addresses, *, reached_node_ids) returns the transitive pure closure in topological order, raising reachability_ambiguous when an address has no unique producer. Tests: new tests/test_workflow_pure_result_replay_index.py compiling small .orc fixtures via the existing compile helpers used in tests/test_workflow_lisp_pure_projection_runtime.py (eligible chain, loop-owned ineligible, wrong-typed literal, malformed ref, cycle, imported callee scope, scope mismatch, serialized runtime plan unchanged before/after).

7. Extract a side-effect-free evaluation core from orchestrator/workflow/steps/pure_projection.py: a function (e.g. evaluate_pure_projection_values(payload, resolved_bindings, output_contracts) -> (values, error)) that evaluates the pure expression and validates output contracts with no bundle path, no file I/O and no state writes, returning typed errors that map to pure_evaluation_failed / pure_projection_contract_invalid. execute_pure_projection keeps calling it so historical behaviour is identical. Covered by existing tests/test_workflow_lisp_pure_projection_runtime.py and tests/test_workflow_lisp_pure_projection_cache.py (run unchanged).

8. OutcomeRecorder settlement (orchestrator/workflow/outcomes.py). Add keyword eligible_pure_settlement: PureReplayVisitWitness | None = None to persist_step_result. When set and the finalized result is completed: call state_manager.settle_eligible_pure_success(witness) instead of update_step, keep the full finalized result (with artifacts) in in-memory state['steps'], pass the exact shell to summary_emitter, return finalized. When failed or skipped: call settle_eligible_pure_failure(witness, to_step_result(...)). Leave the historical branch untouched. Tests: new cases in tests/test_workflow_pure_result_shell.py or a small tests/test_workflow_outcomes_pure_settlement.py using a real StateManager on tmp_path (no mocks).

9. Executor write path under the profile (orchestrator/workflow/executor.py dispatch at the pure_projection branches ~5704/5882 and _execute_pure_projection ~10604; orchestrator/workflow/steps/pure_projection.py). Build the replay index lazily once per executor when the loaded state has result_persistence_profile == DERIVED_PURE_REPLAY_PROFILE. For an eligible node: open the visit with begin_eligible_pure_visit (or reuse_interrupted_eligible_pure_visit on resume), evaluate in memory via the step-7 core with no output bundle file, no _reuse_pure_projection_bundle, no private_artifact_versions finalize-with-dataflow entry, record the full validated result in the PureReplayRuntime cache (record_full_result), then persist via OutcomeRecorder with eligible_pure_settlement=witness. Ineligible pure nodes and the historical profile follow the existing path unchanged; workflow_outputs are produced from the in-memory values so they are unchanged.

10. Replay runtime: new module orchestrator/workflow/pure_result_replay_runtime.py with PureReplayRuntime(*, bundle, scope_path) (scope_path is ResumeScopePath from orchestrator/workflow/resume_projection_integrity.py; index scope_kind derived from it). Implement witness / witness_from_state, node_id_for_step_id (durable step id -> eligible node, raw node id -> None), record_full_result, replay_node (evaluates over the overlay through the injected callable; never increments visits, settles or writes), value_for_state_address / resolve_state_address, required_node_ids_for_boundary, audit_boundary_leaves (validates only the needed bound-input and durable leaves: durable_input_missing / durable_input_invalid including mistyped exit_code and outcome status/phase/class/retryable), overlay_active_state (state copy plus transient rows; never overrides current durable rows). Cache hits revalidate visit == 1 and either the exact durable shell or the exact cached active result, rejecting a current_step cursor on the same presentation name or step id with progress_witness_invalid. Union rows hold exactly discriminant + shared + active-variant outputs (missing active / extra inactive member -> dependency_index_invalid). Re-derivation failures map to binding_unresolved (cause materialize_ref_unresolved), evaluation_failed (pure_evaluation_failed) and output_contract_invalid (pure_projection_contract_invalid). Tests: new tests/test_workflow_pure_result_replay_runtime.py.

11. Persisted-surface conflict audit in the same module: audit_persisted_surfaces(*, state, state_manager, resolve_bundle_path) raises PureResultReplayIndexError('profile_conflict', context.surface=...) for an eligible node's value row ('steps'), existing pure bundle file ('pure_bundle'), private lineage entry ('private_artifact_versions'), same-scope checkpoint record whose pending_effect_policy.effect_kind is pure_projection or whose point is the eligible node ('checkpoint_record'), and restore binding whose source_step_id is an eligible step ('restore_payload'); noneligible recurrent records and other frames' records pass. Reads checkpoint records through the existing resolvers in orchestrator/workflow_lisp/lexical_checkpoints.py (resolve_checkpoint_index_path / resolve_checkpoint_record_path); performs no writes. Tests in tests/test_workflow_pure_result_replay_runtime.py.

12. Checkpoint emission and selection under the profile. orchestrator/workflow/executor.py (emit_runtime_shadow_record call sites ~11676/11709/11814) and orchestrator/workflow_lisp/lexical_checkpoints.py: skip record emission for replay-eligible pure points in a profiled scope. orchestrator/workflow_lisp/lexical_checkpoint_restore.py capture_restore_payload: omit derivable eligible-pure bindings from payloads; select_restore_candidate filters eligible points from candidates. orchestrator/workflow_lisp/lexical_checkpoint_default_resume.py: in _nearest_prior_effect_boundary filter eligible pure points out before unique-nearest selection while never scanning past an invalid nearest durable boundary (restorable nearest noneligible -> 'validated_prior_boundary', non-restorable -> FAIL_CLOSED with ['lexical_default_resume_prior_boundary_not_restorable']); an unstarted eligible point keeps node-local authority; in determine_runtime_default_resume_decision add the single zero-record case restore_decision 'VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY', mode 'LEXICAL_CHECKPOINT_DEFAULT', checkpoint_id None, selection_reason 'validated_frame_entry_replay', admitted only with validated bound-input leaves plus exact profile and progress witnesses, else FAIL_CLOSED as above. Historical profile paths unchanged. Tests: extend tests/test_workflow_lisp_lexical_checkpoints.py, tests/test_workflow_lisp_lexical_checkpoint_restore.py and tests/test_workflow_lisp_lexical_checkpoint_default_resume.py.

13. Single restart-boundary determination (orchestrator/workflow/resume_planner.py, orchestrator/workflow/executor.py ~1480-1510, ~3740, ~4048-4059). Compute restart_node_id once per resume in execute() and pass it down: determine_default_resume_decision(..., restart_node_id=...) and determine_lexical_restore_decision(..., restart_node_id=...) take it as a keyword and no longer call determine_restart_node_id internally; determine_restart_index derives from the same value. Update existing callers in tests/test_resume_command.py (lines ~2033, 2115, 2151, 5406) to pass restart_node_id, and add a test that counts exactly one determine_restart_node_id call per resume (instrument via a ResumePlanner subclass, not a mock).

14. Resume wiring (orchestrator/workflow/executor.py resume prologue; orchestrator/workflow/calls.py for child frames). When the loaded state carries the profile: construct PureReplayRuntime with executor.resume_scope_path, run audit_persisted_surfaces and classify every eligible witness (visit-two cursor / visit-two shell -> progress_witness_invalid) before the prologue or any state write; compute required_node_ids_for_boundary for the restart node, audit_boundary_leaves, replay_node each required node over overlay_active_state, and use the overlay for binding resolution of downstream steps. Any PureResultReplayIndexError fails the run before any effect via the existing fail_run path with error.type 'pure_result_replay_unavailable' and error.context.reason (plus context.cause for re-derivation failures). Eligible nodes found 'derived_complete' are not re-executed; 'interrupted' reuses the visit.

15. Profile selection for roots and frames. orchestrator/cli/commands/run.py (~436): pass result_persistence_profile=DERIVED_PURE_REPLAY_PROFILE to state_manager.initialize only for a successfully compiled typed public .orc run. orchestrator/cli/commands/resume.py (~493-524): the new .orc root created by --force-restart selects the profile and keeps the requested observability; the source run directory is not touched. orchestrator/workflow/call_frame_state.py: add load_existing_call_frame_read_only(existing_frame) returning a deep-copied state mapping without mkdir/writes and raising ValueError mentioning 'existing call-frame state' for a frame with no state or a non-mapping state; _CallFrameStateManager uses it before creating directories and accepts result_persistence_profile for fresh frames only (never backfills existing). orchestrator/workflow/calls.py (~1040-1215): select the profile for a fresh non-iterative child frame when the validated imported bundle provenance has frontend_kind == 'workflow_lisp' (including force_fresh_workflow_lisp_retry frames; the failed predecessor frame stays unchanged); iteration-owned frames, non-Workflow-Lisp callees and existing frames get None; never derive it from the parent profile, alias, path or step id. Tests: tests/test_at68_resume_force_restart.py (source bytes unchanged, profile + observability on new root), the existing orchestrator run CLI test module, tests/test_subworkflow_calls.py (fresh WL callee, non-WL callee, iteration-owned, retry after failed predecessor, malformed existing frame rejected before any write, read-only loader writes nothing).

16. Provider observation manager lifecycle (orchestrator/workflow/executor.py ~244-325, ~485-510, ~3789-3830; check child construction in orchestrator/workflow/calls.py ~1241). Move _initialize_provider_observation_manager() out of __init__ into the start of execute(), keep the single owned close at the end of execute(), and create nothing when observation is disabled. Tests: extend the existing provider-observation executor tests (locate with grep for ProviderObservationManager under tests/) to assert construction creates no manager, execution creates one and closes it once.

17. End-to-end behaviour tests: new tests/test_workflow_pure_result_replay_e2e.py driving real .orc fixtures (under tests/fixtures or tmp_path) through the run/resume entry points: clean profiled run leaves no value rows, no pure bundles, no private lineage and no pure_projection checkpoint records, with workflow_outputs equal to a historical-profile run; interruption between two command effects then resume reproduces outputs and does not re-run the committed effect (effect writes a counter file); each fail-closed reason (durable_input_missing/invalid, binding_unresolved, evaluation_failed, output_contract_invalid, progress_witness_invalid, each profile_conflict surface) fails before any effect with the documented error.type/context; ineligible loop-owned pure nodes keep full rows/bundles/checkpoints in a profiled root; historical-profile runs unchanged. No prompt-text assertions.

18. Documentation. specs/state.md: new section 'Derived Pure-Result Persistence Profile' (field, allowed value, fail-closed load, selection rules for roots/frames, eligibility, exact shell, progress classes, replay and failure reasons, conflict surfaces, checkpoint filtering and VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY) and add the optional key to the 'State File Schema' example; schema stays 2.1. docs/capability_status_matrix.md: add an implemented row routing to specs/state.md. Update the plan doc from step 1 with execution evidence.

19. Verification. Run narrow selectors first (pytest tests/test_state_manager.py tests/test_workflow_pure_result_shell.py tests/test_workflow_pure_result_replay_index.py tests/test_workflow_pure_result_replay_runtime.py -q), then pytest --collect-only on every new/renamed test module, then the touched existing suites (tests/test_resume_command.py tests/test_at68_resume_force_restart.py tests/test_subworkflow_calls.py tests/test_workflow_lisp_lexical_checkpoint*.py tests/test_workflow_lisp_pure_projection_*.py tests/test_workflow_pure_result_replay_e2e.py), then the full suite. Because runtime and artifact contracts change, also run one orchestrator smoke check: `python -m orchestrator run` on a small .orc demo with a pure projection between effects, interrupt and `python -m orchestrator resume <run_id>`, and inspect state.json for the exact shells and absence of pure bundles. Commit incrementally after each green step.

findings: Must fix — Steps 4 and 9 do not replace the executor's actual visit-opening path. orchestrator/workflow/executor.py:_execute_step_loop calls _increment_step_visit (a state write) and then start_step (a second write) before pure dispatch. A crash between them leaves visit=1 without a cursor, which the proposed classifier rejects; resuming an interrupted visit also increments it to 2. Branch at this loop point for eligible pure nodes, call the new atomic begin/reuse methods there, and keep the local state counters in sync.

Must fix — The planned resume audit is too late to satisfy its before-any-write guarantee. orchestrator/cli/commands/resume.py opens an executor session in state.json and writes process metadata before execute(); _CallFrameStateManager.__init__ and update_bound_input_resume_validation also persist before a child execute(); ProviderObservationManager.__init__ creates directories. Put a read-only profile preflight before these mutations, including existing child frames, and allocate the observation manager only after it passes.

Must fix — Step 12's zero-record admission lacks proof that frame entry is the safe restart boundary. OutcomeRecorder commits a command result before its post-persist checkpoint hook, so a crash can leave a completed effect row with zero checkpoint records. Bound-input and pure-progress witnesses alone would admit VALIDATED_FRAME_ENTRY_REPLAY in that state. Require a validated effect-free prefix to the restart point and reject any committed or in-flight effect when using the zero-record case; test that crash window.

Must fix — Step 14 replays only the pure closure required by the immediate restart node. If an earlier pure node feeds a later effect but not the restart effect, that later binding still reads a shell with no artifacts and fails. Define required_node_ids_for_boundary to cover all live pure producers needed across the resumed suffix, or make state-address lookup replay them on demand before resolution; test a value first consumed after the restart step.

Must fix — The specified error envelope is not wired through all replay failure paths. A replay/index error during fresh pure dispatch or a later resume-time binding currently reaches orchestrator/workflow/executor.py:_execute_step_loop's generic exception handler, which stores executor_unhandled_exception and re-raises. Catch PureResultReplayIndexError at the shared execution boundary and persist pure_result_replay_unavailable with its reason and cause before any subsequent effect; cover fresh and resumed failures.

Should fix — Step 17 lacks a crash-point test for the core atomicity claim. An uninterrupted end-to-end run cannot distinguish one atomic visit transaction from the current two-write sequence or prove the exact shell survives a process restart. Inject termination after visit opening and after settlement, reload state from disk, and verify interrupted visit reuse and exact value-free completion.
